# Scout MCP

> A multi-tenant MCP server that gives agents read access to Postgres, Elasticsearch, Qdrant and S3, with a four-agent support copilot on top. Python 3.11, MCP SDK 2.x, Streamable HTTP behind Caddy, OAuth 2.1 tokens from Keycloak.

Read MEMORY.md first. It holds the rules for working in this repo: never start Docker locally, never print or commit `.env`, run the stack only in GitHub Actions, publish only measured numbers.

## Docs
- [MEMORY.md](MEMORY.md): state, rules, decisions, open work
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, quick start, production checklist
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): request path and components
- [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md): the copilot, its limits, and the rules for adding a tool
- [docs/DATA-MODEL.md](docs/DATA-MODEL.md): schemas, row-level security, indexes
- [docs/PERFORMANCE.md](docs/PERFORMANCE.md): numbers measured in CI, with the scripts that measured them
- [docs/ISSUES.md](docs/ISSUES.md): every defect found, the fix and the test that guards it
- [docs/PRD.md](docs/PRD.md): requirements

## Code
- [src/scout_mcp/server.py](src/scout_mcp/server.py): server and the request pipeline (`_run_pipeline`)
- [src/scout_mcp/tools/](src/scout_mcp/tools/): one file per tool; base class in `base.py`, registry in `registry.py`
- [config/policy.yaml](config/policy.yaml): who may call what
- [src/scout_mcp/agents/](src/scout_mcp/agents/): planner, retriever, synthesizer, critic, and the LLM client with its model fallback
- [tests/](tests/): in-process tests; `tests/e2e/` needs the running stack (`SCOUT_E2E=1`)

## Use it
- Connect an MCP client to `https://localhost:8443/mcp` with a bearer token from Keycloak (client-credentials grant, realm `scout`, audience `scout-mcp`).
- Add a tool: follow the rules in docs/AGENTS.md. A tool needs scopes, a policy rule granting them, approval if it writes, and a test; `tests/test_hardening.py` checks the first three.
- LLM: `SCOUT_LLM_MODEL` then `SCOUT_LLM_FALLBACK_MODEL`, both OpenRouter free models by default. The free tier allows about 50 requests a day without credit.
